verdict.rationale: Notion offers AI features like Q&A with citations (notion-docs-7) and agents (notion-docs-8) that imply natural-language interaction within the product, plus an MCP server (notion-probe-3) enabling NL command execution via AI clients. However, evidence doesn't show natural-language command execution as a core native UI feature (e.g., a command bar that interprets arbitrary NL instructions) independent of third-party AI agents/MCP tooling. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a native NL command interface within the Notion app itself, hands-on evidence of reliability/accuracy of NL commands, and independent corroboration beyond marketing copy.
